sources.title: Visa information for Nepali nationals
sources.publisher: Embassy of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, Kathmandu
sources.officialityEvidence: Bangladesh's official Ministry of Foreign Affairs mission page is marked updated 1 January 2026 and directly states the Nepali-national tourist arrival-visa rule. Its current TLS chain is incomplete, so the source needs periodic secure-access recheck.

policies.title: Bhutanese ordinary passports: Bangladesh visa on arrival
policies.summary: Bhutan's current Foreign Ministry notice confirms that Bhutanese passport holders may use Bangladesh's visa-on-arrival facility.
conditions: Applies to a Bhutanese ordinary passport holder visiting Bangladesh for a short stay.
Visa issuance is at arrival; carry accommodation details in Bangladesh and a return air ticket.
Military and security officials must complete formalities with the Bangladesh Embassy in Thimphu before travel.
Residence, work, study, transit, special passports and final admission are outside scope.

policies.title: Nepali ordinary passports: Bangladesh tourist visa on arrival
policies.summary: Bangladesh's current Kathmandu Embassy guidance allows a Nepali national a single-entry tourist visa at a Bangladesh international airport once yearly.
conditions: Applies to a Nepali ordinary passport holder visiting Bangladesh for tourism.
A 30-day single-entry visa may be issued at any Bangladesh international airport once per year.
Bangladesh's general eligibility selector currently returns a conflicting mission-visa result; the newer passport-specific Embassy guidance controls this policy.
Residence, work, study, transit, special passports and final admission are outside scope.

conflicts.explanation: Bhutan's current Foreign Ministry notice confirms Bangladesh visa on arrival for Bhutanese passport holders; the fallback's visa-free status is incorrect.
